speaker: Doctor
text: The inability to flex your distal interphalangeal joint combined with the finger resting in an extended position suggests a potential injury to the flexor digitorum profundus tendon or an intrinsic muscle rupture. Was your finger bent or extended at the moment of the jersey pull, and did you feel a sudden snap or tearing sensation?

text:

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: MRI of the Right Hand: Preliminary findings indicate a complete discontinuity of the flexor digitorum profundus tendon at the distal interphalangeal joint of the right ring finger, consistent with a tendon rupture. speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Ruptured Flexor Digitorum Profundus Tendon of the Right Ring Finger.
